# Player at (33, 12), need to go around B blocks at (30,27) and (30,33)
# Path: UP, RIGHT, RIGHT, DOWN, RIGHT, RIGHT, UP, RIGHT, RIGHT, UP

# Verify B block positions
seg = current_frame.segmentation
b_blocks = []
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] < 100:
        boundary = n['boundary']
        min_r = min(p[0] for p in boundary)
        min_c = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
        max_r = max(p[0] for p in boundary)
        max_c = max(p[1] for p in boundary)
        b_blocks.append((min_r, min_c, max_r, max_c))
        print(f"B block: ({min_r},{min_c}) to ({max_r},{max_c})")

# Player is 3x3, so body at (r,c) occupies rows r..r+2, cols c..c+2
def body_overlaps_b(r, c, b_blocks):
    for br, bc, br2, bc2 in b_blocks:
        if not (r+2 < br or r > br2 or c+2 < bc or c > bc2):
            return True
    return False

# Check each position in the path
path = [(33,12), (27,12), (27,18), (27,24), (33,24), (33,30), (33,36), (27,36), (27,42), (27,48), (21,48)]
print("\nPath check:")
for r, c in path:
    overlaps = body_overlaps_b(r, c, b_blocks)
    print(f"  ({r},{c}): overlaps B = {overlaps}")

# Execute the path
moves = ['UP', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'DOWN', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'UP', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'UP']
print(f"\nExecuting {len(moves)} moves...")
action(moves)
print(f"Result: level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}, done={last_action_result.get('done')}, game_over={last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
